description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions related to OAuth client registration and redirect URI validation within the Mattermost project.

classes.name: ClientRegistrationRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to register an OAuth client, including redirect URIs and optional client metadata.

classes.name: ClientRegistrationResponse
classes.description: Represents the response containing client credentials and metadata after registration.

classes.name: DCRError
classes.description: Represents an error related to Dynamic Client Registration (DCR).

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the ClientRegistrationRequest for correctness and completeness.

methods.name: NewDCRError
methods.description: Creates a new DCRError with specified error type and description.

methods.name: GetDefaultGrantTypes
methods.description: Returns the default OAuth grant types.

methods.name: GetDefaultResponseTypes
methods.description: Returns the default OAuth response types.

methods.name: IsValidDCRRedirectURIPattern
methods.description: Validates a redirect URI pattern for allowlisting, ensuring proper scheme and format.

methods.name: RedirectURIMatchesGlob
methods.description: Checks if a URI matches a glob pattern with wildcards.

methods.name: redirectURIMatchesGlobRecur
methods.description: Recursive helper for matching URI against glob pattern.

methods.name: RedirectURIMatchesAllowlist
methods.description: Checks if a URI matches at least one pattern in an allowlist.
